svg.title: Where an extension reaches
svg.desc: An extension folder holds skills, commands and agent profiles, modules without a connector block, and modules with one. Skills, commands and agent profiles go to your Claude Code and OpenCode sessions. A module without a connector block is always on: its tools and hooks go to your sessions and to the workers you start from them, and to the workers the clone starts only where the module is marked as served to workers. A module with a connector block does the same only while its switch on Set up is on, and then also gives clone turns the tools it declares for them. A worker can call a tool only when its profile names it.
